archive_identity_scope: The manifest binds each exact archived file. The named pre-packaging commit pins the latest published source/report state; generated ARCHIVE_LEDGER_BINDINGS.json and ARCHIVE_RUNTIME_ENVIRONMENT.json were added locally before packaging and are separately manifest-bound. No claim is made that every payload is a Git tree at that commit.

persistence.requires_explicit_authorization: Name the concrete V2/V3 archives and verification reports and authorize saving them to ChatGPT Library. The earlier generic continuation was explicitly insufficient for the blocked V2 action; no alternate egress or upload retry has been attempted.

independent_development_selection.arithmetic_contract: paired per-example deltas; mean over path and condition-major sample axes before comparator ranking

independent_runtime_gate.draw_order: each replicate: paired rollout matrix if R>1; then one paired source-index vector per panel in declared order
independent_runtime_gate.interpretation: Conjunction across observers; fixed historical model seeds; source/rollout bootstrap is approximate, not simultaneous coverage of both observers' intervals

archived_source_statistical_reanalysis.scope: Archive byte integrity and exact arithmetic replay; earlier bound hard-media/observer/native truth proofs are preserved, not repeated

build.compression: gzip level6, mtime0; USTAR regular files only

independent_ledger_archive_coverage.scope: Read-only cross-check of immutable ledger and archive mapping against the pinned successful full-member integrity receipt. Every ledger original and mapped local archive input was hashed; the ten relocated copies were also compared byte for byte. No archive stream, scientific outcome, or execution stage was rerun.

sidecar_sequence: This final verification receipt and the underlying actual archive receipts are necessarily produced after archive construction and remain outside its manifest, avoiding a self-referential archive hash. Scientific sources and original study receipts inside the archive are unchanged.
verification_scope: Full byte/CRC verification of every archive payload, literal 50-file selective restoration, exact development/runtime statistical replay using archived algorithms, and complete immutable-ledger byte coverage. Earlier actual hard-media/observer/native proofs are preserved and bound; archive replay does not repeat model execution.
